data.content_ref: inline:The isolated node reduces to a threshold-placement rule over bounded integer weights: the diagnostic post-pass family (defense depth, residue, fragility, defense witnesses) is a monotone function of the weight of attack edges incident to committed roots, so the post-pass is not an extra mechanism but the same grounded fixpoint read at a threshold τ. Refuted if a committed run in the anchor library exhibits a defense-depth ordering that is not reproduced by any threshold τ while committed-root validity holds.
